summary: LG Display furnished a Form -K disclosing that the Korea Exchange designated it an Unfaithful Disclosure Corporation on November 3, 2026, after the company delayed reporting an alleged officer/employee embezzlement or misappropriation (occurrence February 10, 2026; disclosed October 14, 2026). The designation carries zero newly imposed demerit points, a KRW 8,000,000 fine, and no request to replace the disclosure officer; listing-maintenance review grounds were deemed inapplicable. Under KOSPI rules, 10 or more demerit points in a one-year window could trigger a substantive listing review. Watch for follow-on disclosures and governance or listing-status risk rather than deal terms.
